Fewer buyers, softer prices. TRREB reports the average selling price across the GTA was $1,006,409 in September 2026, down 5.1% from September 2025, while the MLS® HPI Composite benchmark was down 4.7% year over year. Homes took an average of 51 days to sell. Every neighbourhood and home type is different.

4 programs every first-time buyer in Ontario should know: the FHSA ($8,000 annual limit, $40,000 lifetime limit), the Home Buyers' Plan (up to $60,000 RRSP withdrawal per person), the Ontario land transfer tax refund (up to $4,000) and the federal GST rebate on qualifying new homes (up to $50,000). Save this and send it to someone saving for a first home. Eligibility rules apply, check the official government pages. Not tax, mortgage or legal advice.
